sourceTitle: Love Me Little, Love Me Long
description: "Love Me Little, Love Me Long" by Charles Reade is a novel written during the mid-19th century. The story primarily revolves around Lucy Fountain, a young lady navigating her social relationships and the expectations placed upon her due to familial obligations and societal norms.
